options.content: 🏠 Accueil📟 Vue d'ensemble🕒 Chronologie💤 États🚗 Trajets📈 Stats conduite🧳 Voyage🛣️ Kilométrage🍃 Efficacité🔌 Recharges📊 Stats recharge⚡ Énergie réelle🔋 Santé batterie🎚️ Niveau de charge📏 Autonomie🧛 Pertes à l'arrêt🌡️ Températures📍 Lieux🗺️ Visites🗓️ Statistiques⬆️ Mises à jour🗄️ Base de données
📊 EN CHIFFRES  —  sur la période choisie (1 an par défaut)

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (SELECT cp.*, charge.typ, (charge.typ = 'DC' AND (COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) ILIKE '%supercharg%' OR COALESCE(charge.tesla, false))) AS suc, greatest(cp.charge_energy_added, cp.charge_energy_used) AS wall
  FROM charging_processes cp LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
  JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(c.fast_charger_present) OR NULLIF(max(c.charger_phases), 0) IS NULL THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END AS typ,
                       bool_or(c.fast_charger_brand = 'Tesla') AS tesla
                FROM charges c WHERE c.charging_process_id = cp.id) charge ON true
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
km AS (SELECT sum(distance) AS km FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) AND end_date IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*) AS "Recharges", sum(charge_energy_added) AS "Ajouté", sum(wall) AS "Prise", sum(cost) AS "Coût",
  sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE suc) AS "Superchargeurs", sum(cost) / nullif(sum(wall) FILTER (WHERE cost IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "Prix kWh",
  sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'AC') / nullif(sum(wall) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'AC' AND cost IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "Prix AC",
  sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'DC') / nullif(sum(wall) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'DC' AND cost IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "Prix DC",
  sum(cost) * 100 / nullif((SELECT km FROM km), 0) AS "Coût aux 100 km",
  sum(charge_energy_added) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'AC') / nullif(sum(wall) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'AC'), 0) * 100 AS "Rendement AC",
  sum(charge_energy_added) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'DC') / nullif(sum(charge_energy_added), 0) * 100 AS "Part DC",
  sum(charge_energy_added) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'AC') AS "Ajouté AC", sum(charge_energy_added) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'DC') AS "Ajouté DC",
  sum(duration_min) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'AC') * 60 AS "Durée AC", sum(duration_min) FILTER (WHERE typ = 'DC') * 60 AS "Durée DC"
FROM x

options.content: 📍 OÙ ET COMMENT  —  lieux, types de borne et niveaux de charge

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) AS "Lieu", avg(p.latitude) AS latitude, avg(p.longitude) AS longitude, sum(cp.charge_energy_added) AS "kWh",
  count(*) AS "Recharges"
FROM charging_processes cp LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = cp.position_id WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 GROUP BY 1

SELECT (floor(cp.start_battery_level / 10) * 10)::int || ' %' AS "Niveau", count(*) AS "Recharges"
FROM charging_processes cp WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 GROUP BY floor(cp.start_battery_level / 10) ORDER BY floor(cp.start_battery_level / 10)

panels.title: À quel niveau tu débranches
panels.description: Au quotidien, 80 % ménage une batterie NMC ; une batterie LFP peut aller à 100 %.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (round(cp.end_battery_level / 5.0) * 5)::int || ' %' AS "Niveau", count(*) AS "Recharges"
FROM charging_processes cp WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 GROUP BY round(cp.end_battery_level / 5.0) ORDER BY round(cp.end_battery_level / 5.0)

SELECT soc AS "Batterie", pw AS "Mesures", med AS "Médiane" FROM (
  SELECT c.battery_level AS soc, c.charger_power::float AS pw, NULL::float AS med
  FROM charges c JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.id = c.charging_process_id
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(c.date) AND c.fast_charger_present AND c.charger_power > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.battery_level, NULL, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.charger_power)
  FROM charges c JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.id = c.charging_process_id
  WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(c.date) AND c.fast_charger_present AND c.charger_power > 0 GROUP BY c.battery_level) x
ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) AS "Lieu", sum(cp.charge_energy_added) AS "kWh" FROM charging_processes cp LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = cp.position_id WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(a.name, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', a.road, a.house_number), '')), COALESCE(a.city, a.neighbourhood))) AS "Lieu", sum(cp.cost) AS "Coût" FROM charging_processes cp LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
  LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = cp.position_id WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 AND cp.cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', cp.start_date), '$__timezone') AS time, sum(cp.cost) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(c.fast_charger_present) OR NULLIF(max(c.charger_phases), 0) IS NULL THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END FROM charges c WHERE c.charging_process_id = cp.id) = 'AC') AS "AC",
  sum(cp.cost) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN bool_or(c.fast_charger_present) OR NULLIF(max(c.charger_phases), 0) IS NULL THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END FROM charges c WHERE c.charging_process_id = cp.id) = 'DC') AS "DC"
FROM charging_processes cp WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date) AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
